A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''contractor''' specialized in magnetic containment vessels. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], he was aboard the civilian transport vessel ''[[Nordieus]]'' en route to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] while it was under construction at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Despayre]]. He tried engaging [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Atour Riten]], who was also on the same flight, in talking about the technical requirements of powering the space station.<ref name="DS" />
